title: LLMs & AI Agents
summary: How large language models work, and how to build agents on top of them. Start after Machine Learning Foundations.

stages.title: Transformers
stages.passCriteria: You can build a tiny GPT and explain every part of it.

stages.title: Large Language Models
stages.passCriteria: You can explain pretraining, fine-tuning and LoRA, and fine-tune a small model.

stages.title: Building with LLMs
stages.passCriteria: You can build a retrieval-augmented app and measure whether its answers are right.

stages.title: AI Agents
stages.passCriteria: You can build an agent that uses tools, and evaluate it.
